items.title: AI for Science program expands to foundations and research institutions
items.summary_en: Anthropic names 20 scientific foundations, institutions and research groups as partners in its expanding AI for Science program. The post presents this as a push to bring Claude into research beyond individual labs.
items.notes: From newsroom index summary; post not opened.

items.title: Early progress on accelerating drug development with Claude
items.summary_en: Anthropic says its scientists have spent several months in research partnerships with six drug developers. It describes this as the start of a larger effort to speed up medicine development with Claude.
items.notes: From index summary; results not verified.

items.title: Anthropic expands partnership with GSA for government use of Claude
items.summary_en: A new agreement with the US General Services Administration gives government partners a reported 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government and the Claude API.
items.notes: From index summary; check discount figure.

items.title: Anthropic files S-1 with the SEC for a proposed IPO
items.summary_en: Anthropic, PBC announced that it has filed a registration statement with the SEC for a proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
items.notes: From index summary; offering size/timing not captured.

items.title: Anthropic donates Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
items.summary_en: Anthropic is giving Agent Skills, its open standard for specialized agent knowledge and workflows, to the Agentic AI Foundation. The post says more than 70 agent platforms have adopted the standard since its December 2025 release.

items.title: Open call for guest investigators in the life sciences
items.summary_en: Anthropic invites life sciences researchers to apply for special projects in collaboration with its team.
items.notes: From index summary; deadline not captured.

items.title: Physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust
items.summary_en: Anthropic announced that Dr. Christopher Stubbs, a former Harvard Dean of Science, has joined its Long-Term Benefit Trust.
items.notes: From index summary; on the window boundary.
